title: Zebras - Grant's Zebra Braying
author: TheKingOfGeeks360
changes: Grant's zebra (Equus quagga boehmi), a plains zebra, giving its barking 'kwa-ha' bray at a zoo. Trimmed to 0.22–3.12 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.3 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording.
